verdict.rationale: UK Visas and Immigration is a government immigration authority that holds applicants' records itself. Letting a user pick the region or residency of their data storage is a SaaS-platform capability, not something a buyer comparing visa and immigration services would reasonably ask, so this axis is a category error. The only privacy-related item, the right to see personal information UKVI holds, concerns subject access rather than storage location and does not make the axis applicable.
